text: Who are the best wills and estates lawyers in Brisbane Southside (Mount Gravatt & Sunnybank) for drafting wills, testamentary trusts, and enduring powers of attorney?

sections.text:
For **Brisbane Southside**, the strongest local shortlist is:

- **Bennett Carroll Solicitors — Upper Mount Gravatt:** A practical full-service option with a Brisbane South office, offering wills, testamentary trusts and enduring powers of attorney. The firm reports more than 50 years of combined wills-and-estates experience.[1][2]
- **Campbells Legal — Upper Mount Gravatt:** A family-run Southside practice operating since 1986, with a dedicated wills and estates service.[3]
- **Wheldon & Associates — Sunnybank:** A local firm advertising succession planning and deceased-estate administration, suitable if you want a Sunnybank-based practice that can also assist if complications arise later.[5]
- **Grasso Searles Romano Lawyers — South-East Brisbane:** Offers estate planning and enduring powers of attorney, with particularly substantial general legal, accounting and tax experience through principal Alfio Romano.[5]
- **Direct Lawyers — mobile South-East Queensland service:** A good option if home appointments or a highly focused estate-planning practice are useful; services specifically include testamentary trusts, EPOAs, superannuation planning and estate-litigation protection.[6]

For **complex estates**, especially business ownership, significant tax issues, blended families, vulnerable beneficiaries or asset-protection concerns, also consider a larger Brisbane succession team:

- **Cooper Grace Ward:** Specifically handles wills with testamentary trusts and EPOAs, working alongside tax, superannuation, estate-administration and disputes lawyers.[7]
- **Thynne + Macartney:** Its wills-and-estates team has more than 50 years’ experience and includes recognised specialists; it covers testamentary trusts, EPOAs, superannuation, incapacity and succession planning.[8]

### Best fit by situation

| Situation | First calls |
|---|---|
| Convenient Mount Gravatt appointment | Bennett Carroll; Campbells Legal |
| Convenient Sunnybank appointment | Wheldon & Associates; Grasso Searles Romano |
| Home/mobile appointment | Direct Lawyers |
| Complex trust, tax or business succession | Cooper Grace Ward; Thynne + Macartney |
| Possible future estate dispute | Thynne + Macartney; Cooper Grace Ward; Wheldon & Associates |

When comparing quotes, ask whether the fee includes **individual wills, a testamentary discretionary trust, EPOAs for both financial and personal/health matters, an advance health directive, superannuation-beneficiary advice, execution/witnessing and future document storage**. A testamentary trust should be tailored to the family’s tax, control, asset-protection and beneficiary needs rather than added automatically. Also confirm that the lawyer is currently admitted in Queensland and ask who will review the documents if circumstances change.
